Authenticate every request to the order portal and to the ordering assistant against the corporate identity provider
Evaluate access policy per request (role, device, context, customer contract scope) before order, stock or contract data is released
Cache policy decisions for 5 minutes for non-privileged read requests while re-verifying every privileged action
Require step-up multi-factor authentication for privileged actions (contract price changes, bulk data export, quarantine release, access rights changes)
Verify the requester's identity and entitlement before releasing contract, price or personal data to a hospital buyer or an external party
Review all user, service and assistant access rights per role every quarter and revoke rights that are no longer justified
Record each access review and each revocation in the access review register and close it within the quarter
Issue the ordering assistant a short-lived credential bound to the named hospital buyer or sales administrator for each session, never a standing service identity
Log every verified request with user identity, assistant session, and the order, batch or contract record accessed
